title: Which NBA team will sign Trey Alexander to a two-way contract in the first two weeks of July 2026?
background: A two-way contract allows a player to play for both an NBA team and its G League affiliate.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : as confirmed by a team announcement or contemporaneous sports reporting  
       Resolution Date : Resolve to the NBA team that signs Trey Alexander to a two-way contract between July 1 and July 14, 2026, inclusive  
       Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the team's full name.
